concrete_increment: A bounded correction to the move from identity-making causal provenance to a determinate total personal chronology for multiply instantiated artworks; selecting edges does not supply comparability. Graph facts and self-loop/edge-selection arguments are inherited.
closest_overlap: Maslen 2024 section 4 explicitly includes multiple-instance artworks and asserts general causal ordering; Hall 2014 already restricts to immanent identity-making causation; Gustafsson analyzes branching persistence using personal time.
limitations: Excerpt-only bounded search. No direct Wasserman/Effingham books or exhaustive artwork ontology survey. Charitable partial-order or career-relative readings narrow the result; realization individuation and aggregate-stage response remain draft burdens. Does not show inability to detect every backward trip.
